name: What materials are used for window screen repair?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for window screen repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use various durable materials for window screen repair to suit different needs. Common options include fiberglass mesh, which is flexible and resistant to creasing; aluminum mesh, known for its strength and longevity; and specialty meshes like pet-resistant screening, which is thicker and more durable against animal claws, or solar screening for UV protection. We discuss the best material for your specific requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use fiberglass, aluminum, pet-resistant, or solar mesh, depending on your needs and preference.
